structure:Codelist.common:Name: Macroeconomic and financial accounts
structure:Codelist.common:Description: A framework for organizing macroeconomic and financial data into a set of integrated accounts and tables that provide a comprehensive overview of an economy.

structure:Code.common:Name: Capital account
structure:Code.common:Description: The capital account records acquisitions and disposals of non-financial assets as a result of transactions with other units, internal bookkeeping transactions linked to production (such as changes in inventories and depreciation) and the redistribution of wealth by means of capital transfers. In the context of the external accounts, the capital account shows (a) capital transfers receivable and payable between residents and nonresidents and (b) the acquisition and disposal of nonproduced, nonfinancial assets between residents and nonresidents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Capital and financial account
structure:Code.common:Description: The capital account records acquisitions and disposals of non-financial assets as a result of transactions with other units, internal bookkeeping transactions linked to production (such as changes in inventories and depreciation) and the redistribution of wealth by means of capital transfers. In the context of the external accounts, the capital account shows (a) capital transfers receivable and payable between residents and nonresidents and (b) the acquisition and disposal of nonproduced, nonfinancial assets between residents and nonresidents. The financial account records all transactions in financial assets and liabilities. In the external accounts, only transactions between residents and non-residents are included.

structure:Code.common:Name: Current account
structure:Code.common:Description: The current account covers the transactions in goods, services, earned income and transfer income for institutional sectors and between residents and non-residents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Current, capital and financial account
structure:Code.common:Description: The current account covers the transactions in goods, services, earned income and transfer income for institutional sectors and between residents and non-residents. The capital account records acquisitions and disposals of non-financial assets as a result of transactions with other units, internal bookkeeping transactions linked to production (such as changes in inventories and depreciation) and the redistribution of wealth by means of capital transfers. In the context of the external accounts, the capital account shows (a) capital transfers receivable and payable between residents and nonresidents and (b) the acquisition and disposal of nonproduced, nonfinancial assets between residents and nonresidents. The financial account records all transactions in financial assets and liabilities. In the external accounts, only transactions between residents and non-residents are included.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial account
structure:Code.common:Description: The financial account records all transactions in financial assets and liabilities. In the external accounts, only transactions between residents and non-residents are included.

structure:Code.common:Name: Currency composition of International Investment Position
structure:Code.common:Description: The breakdown of a country's international investment position by the currency in which the assets and liabilities are denominated.

structure:Code.common:Name: Monetary survey
structure:Code.common:Description: An aggregate financial statement that consolidates the accounts of the central bank and other depository corporations, showing the sources and uses of funds.

structure:Code.common:Name: Fund Accounts
structure:Code.common:Description: A system of accounting used by non-profit organizations and governments to track the use of funds restricted for specific purposes.

structure:Code.common:Name: International Investment Position (IIP)
structure:Code.common:Description: Statement drawn up at a particular point in time of the value of financial assets of residents of an economy that are claims on non-residents or are gold bullion held as reserve assets and of the liabilities of residents of an economy to non-residents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Allocated shares
structure:Code.common:Description: Represents shares of ownership or equity that have been formally assigned or distributed to specific individuals or entities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Statement of operations
structure:Code.common:Description: A statement summarizing the revenues, expenses, and results of operations of government over a specific period.

structure:Code.common:Name: International Investment Position (IIP) - Assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Statement drawn up at a particular point in time of the value of financial assets of residents of an economy that are claims on non-residents or are gold bullion held as reserve assets and of the liabilities of residents of an economy to non-residents.

structure:Code.common:Name: International Investment Position (IIP) - Liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: Statement drawn up at a particular point in time of the value of financial assets of residents of an economy that are claims on non-residents or are gold bullion held as reserve assets and of the liabilities of residents of an economy to non-residents.

structure:Code.common:Name: Statement of other economic flows
structure:Code.common:Description: Captures changes in assets and liabilities that are not due to transactions, such as revaluations, write-offs, and other adjustments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total
structure:Code.common:Description: The sum of all relevant components or categories.

structure:Code.common:Name: Balance Sheet Account
structure:Code.common:Description: The balance sheet account records stocks of nonfinancial assets, financial assets and liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: GDP by income approach
structure:Code.common:Description: Total income earned through the production of goods and services in the economy, consisting of remuneration of employees plus gross operating surplus plus gross mixed incomes plus taxes less subsidies on both production and imports

structure:Code.common:Name: GDP by expenditure approach
structure:Code.common:Description: The value of total output less total intermediate consumption plus any taxes less subsidies on products not already included in the value of output.

structure:Code.common:Name: GDP by production approach
structure:Code.common:Description: Total value added (total output less total intermediate goods used to produce the output) from the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Concentration and distribution measures
structure:Code.common:Description: Statistical measures used to assess the concentration of financial assets or economic activities and their distribution across different sectors or entities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Additional Financial Soundness Indicators
structure:Code.common:Description: Supplementary indicators used to assess the stability and soundness of the financial system, beyond the core set of financial soundness indicators.

structure:Code.common:Name: Additional series - Financial Soundness Indicators
structure:Code.common:Description: Additional data series that provide further insights into the financial soundness of institutions or the financial system as a whole.

structure:Code.common:Name: Balance sheets and income statements
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial statements that provide a snapshot of an entity's financial position (balance sheet) and its performance over a period (income statement).

structure:Code.common:Name: Core Financial Soundness Indicators
structure:Code.common:Description: Key indicators used to assess the financial health and stability of financial institutions, such as capital adequacy, asset quality, earnings, and liquidity.

structure:Code.common:Name: Distribution measures
structure:Code.common:Description: Measures used to analyze the distribution of income, wealth, or other economic variables within a population or sector.

structure:Code.common:Name: Encouraged Financial Soundness Indicators
structure:Code.common:Description: Indicators recommended for use in addition to the core financial soundness indicators to provide a more comprehensive assessment of financial stability.

structure:Code.common:Name: Income and expense statement (FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: A financial statement that shows the revenues, expenses, and profits or losses over a specific period, also known as an income statement or profit and loss statement.

structure:Code.common:Name: Memorandum series: additional series
structure:Code.common:Description: Supplementary data series included in financial or economic reports to provide additional context or insights.

structure:Code.common:Name: Memorandum series: balance sheet-related series
structure:Code.common:Description: Supplementary data series related to balance sheet items, providing additional detail or context.

structure:Code.common:Name: Memorandum series: income statement-related series
structure:Code.common:Description: Supplementary data series related to income statement items, providing additional detail or context.

structure:Code.common:Name: Memorandum series
structure:Code.common:Description: A set of supplementary data series included in financial or economic reports to enhance understanding and analysis.

structure:Code.common:Name: Memorandum series: supervisory-based series
structure:Code.common:Description: Supplementary data series based on information collected by supervisory authorities, often related to regulatory compliance and oversight.

structure:Code.common:Name: Government expenditures by function
structure:Code.common:Description: Government expenditures by function.

structure:Code.common:Name: Statement of sources and uses of cash
structure:Code.common:Description: A summary of the government’s actual cash inflows (receipts) and outflows (payments) over a given period, showing how cash is generated, spent, and how the residual affects the government’s cash balance.

structure:Code.common:Name: Balance Sheet (GFS)
structure:Code.common:Description: A snapshot of the government’s stock of assets and liabilities at a particular point in time, including the resulting net worth (assets minus liabilities).

structure:Code.common:Name: Balance Sheet (FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Balance sheet records stocks of nonfinancial assets, financial assets and liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Stocks and flows by counterparty
structure:Code.common:Description: Stocks and Flows of assets and liabilities by counterparty.

structure:Code.common:Name: Central Bank Balance Sheet
structure:Code.common:Description: Central Bank Balance Sheet.

structure:Code.common:Name: Depository Corporations' Balance Sheet
structure:Code.common:Description: Depository Corporations' Balance Sheet.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other Depository Corporations' Balance Sheet
structure:Code.common:Description: Other Depository Corporations' Balance Sheet.

structure:Codelist.common:Name: Core and Additional Financial Soundness Indicators (FSIs) Indicator

structure:Code.common:Name: Combined ratio (Nonlife insurance only) (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Combined ratio (Nonlife insurance only). Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Combined ratio (Nonlife insurance only), Net claims and underwriting expenses
structure:Code.common:Description: Combined ratio (Nonlife insurance only). Gross claims minus the Reinsurers' share of the gross claims plus Underwriting expenses.

structure:Code.common:Name: Combined ratio (Nonlife insurance only), Net premium earned
structure:Code.common:Description: Combined ratio (Nonlife insurance only). Premiums received by insurance corporations from policyholders during the reporting period, after deducting reinsurance premiums.

structure:Code.common:Name: Commercial real estate loans to total gross loans (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Commercial real estate loans to total gross loans. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Commercial real estate loans to total gross loans, Commercial real estate loans
structure:Code.common:Description: Commercial real estate loans to total gross loans. The sum of Loans collateralized by commercial real estate, loans to construction companies, and loans to companies active in the development of real estate.

structure:Code.common:Name: Commercial real estate loans to total gross loans, Total gross loans
structure:Code.common:Description: Commercial real estate loans to total gross loans. Financial assets created from lending funds directly to debtors, and evidenced by documents that are not negotiable.

structure:Code.common:Name: Commercial real estate prices (percentage change/last 12 months) (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Commercial real estate prices (percentage change/last 12 months). Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Common equity Tier 1 capital to risk-weighted assets (Core FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Common equity tier 1 capital to risk-weighted assets. Core FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Common equity Tier 1 capital to risk-weighted assets, Common equity Tier 1 capital
structure:Code.common:Description: Common equity tier 1 capital to risk-weighted assets. Supervisory concept of the highest quality loss-absorbing capital defined by Basel III, comprising common shares, retained earnings and accumulated other comprehensive income, and other disclosed reserves, less corresponding supervisory deductions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Common equity Tier 1 capital to risk-weighted assets, Risk-weighted assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Common equity tier 1 capital to risk-weighted assets. Total of all on- and off-balance-sheet exposures weighted according to their perceived risk (credit, market, operational).

structure:Code.common:Name: Credit growth to private sector (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Credit growth to private sector. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Credit growth to private sector, Credit to the private sector
structure:Code.common:Description: Credit growth to private sector. Gross loans extended to the private nonfinancial sector, plus debt securities issued by private nonfinancial corporations and held by Deposit takers.

structure:Code.common:Name: Customer deposits to total (noninterbank) loans (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Customer deposits to total (noninterbank) loans. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Customer deposits to total (noninterbank) loans, Customer deposits
structure:Code.common:Description: Customer deposits to total (noninterbank) loans. Deposits placed by residents or nonresidents, except those placed by (resident and nonresident) financial corporations, central governments, and central banks.

structure:Code.common:Name: Customer deposits to total (noninterbank) loans, Noninterbank loans
structure:Code.common:Description: Customer deposits to total (noninterbank) loans. Loans granted to other sectors, other than deposit taking institutions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Earnings to interest and principal expenses (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Earnings to interest and principal expenses. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Earnings to interest and principal expenses, Debt-service payments (interest and principal)
structure:Code.common:Description: Earnings to interest and principal expenses. The interest and principal payable on outstanding debt liabilities during the reporting period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Earnings to interest and principal expenses, Earnings before interest and tax
structure:Code.common:Description: Earnings to interest and principal expenses. The net operating income plus interest income plus other income (net) less interest income receivable from other nonfinancial corporations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Earnings to interest expenses (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Earnings to interest expenses. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Earnings to interest expenses, Earnings before interest and tax
structure:Code.common:Description: Earnings to interest expenses. The net operating income plus interest income plus other income (net) less interest income receivable from other nonfinancial corporations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Earnings to interest expenses, Interest expenses
structure:Code.common:Description: Earnings to interest expenses. Interest accrued and payable on debt instruments such as deposits, loans, debt securities, and other accounts payable.

structure:Code.common:Name: External debt to equity (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: External debt to equity. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: External debt to equity, Equity
structure:Code.common:Description: External debt to equity. The difference between total assets and total liabilities in the balance sheet, and it represents the equity interest of the owners in an entity and is the amount available to absorb unidentified losses.

structure:Code.common:Name: External debt to equity, Total debt to nonresidents
structure:Code.common:Description: External debt to equity. The outstanding amount of those actual current, and not contingent, liabilities that require payment of principal or interest by the debtor in the future and that are owed to nonresidents by resident nonfinancial corporations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign currency debt to equity (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Foreign currency debt to equity. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign currency debt to equity, Equity
structure:Code.common:Description: Foreign currency debt to equity. The difference between total assets and total liabilities in the balance sheet, and it represents the equity interest of the owners in an entity and is the amount available to absorb unidentified losses.

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign currency debt to equity, Total debt in foreign currency
structure:Code.common:Description: Foreign currency debt to equity. The part of nonfinancial corporations' total debt with principal and interest payments denominated in a currency other than the domestic currency, regardless of whether the creditor is resident or a nonresident.

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign currency denominated liabilities to total liabilities (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Foreign currency denominated liabilities to total liabilities Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign currency denominated liabilities to total liabilities, Foreign currency-denominated liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: Foreign currency denominated liabilities to total liabilities Liabilities denominated in a currency other than the domestic currency.

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign currency denominated liabilities to total liabilities, Total liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: Foreign currency denominated liabilities to total liabilities Obligations of the entity to provide cash, financial instruments, or other items of economic value to other institutional units.

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign currency denominated loans to total loans (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Foreign currency denominated loans to total loans Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign currency denominated loans to total loans, Foreign currency denominated loans
structure:Code.common:Description: Foreign currency denominated loans to total loans Loans denominated in a currency other than the domestic currency.

structure:Code.common:Name: Geographic distribution of loans: Advanced Economies (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Geographic distribution of loans: advanced economies. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Geographic distribution of loans: Domestic Economy (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Geographic distribution of loans: Domestic Economy. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Geographic distribution of loans: Emerging and Developing Asia (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Geographic distribution of loans: emerging and developing asia. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Geographic distribution of loans: Emerging and Developing Europe (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Geographic distribution of loans: emerging and developing europe. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Geographic distribution of loans: Emerging Market and Developing Economies (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Geographic distribution of loans: emerging market and developing economies. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Geographic distribution of loans: Latin America and the Caribbean (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Geographic distribution of loans: latin america and the caribbean. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Geographic distribution of loans: Middle East and Central Asia (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Geographic distribution of loans: middle east and central asia. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Geographic distribution of loans: Sub-saharan Africa (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Geographic distribution of loans, sub-saharan africa. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross asset position in financial derivatives to capital (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Gross asset position in financial derivatives to capital. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross asset position in financial derivatives to capital, Gross asset position in financial derivatives
structure:Code.common:Description: Gross asset position in financial derivatives to capital. Financial instruments that are linked to another specific financial instrument, indicator, index, price, interest rate, or commodity, and through which specific financial risks can be traded in their own right in financial markets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross asset position in financial derivatives to capital, Total regulatory capital
structure:Code.common:Description: Gross asset position in financial derivatives to capital. The sum of Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 (when applicable) capital, after accounting for regulatory adjustments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross domestic product (GDP), Current prices
structure:Code.common:Description: Gross domestic product reflects the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period. It can be measured in three different ways: using either the expenditure approach, the income approach, or the production approach. Values expressed without any adjustment for price changes

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross liability position in financial derivatives to capital (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Gross liability position in financial derivatives to capital. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross liability position in financial derivatives to capital, Gross liability position in financial derivatives
structure:Code.common:Description: Gross liability position in financial derivatives to capital. Financial instruments that are linked to another specific financial instrument, indicator, index, price, interest rate, or commodity, and through which specific financial risks can be traded in their own right in financial markets. Employee stock options are contracts that give employees the right to purchase shares of their employer's stock at a predetermined price, usually as part of their compensation package.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross liability position in financial derivatives to capital, Total regulatory capital
structure:Code.common:Description: Gross liability position in financial derivatives to capital. The sum of Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 (when applicable) capital, after accounting for regulatory adjustments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Household debt service and principal payments to income (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Household debt service and principal payments to income. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Household debt service and principal payments to income, Debt-service payments (interest and principal)
structure:Code.common:Description: Household debt service and principal payments to income. The interest and principal payable on outstanding debt liabilities during the reporting period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Household debt service and principal payments to income, Gross disposable income
structure:Code.common:Description: Household debt service and principal payments to income. The remainder of the sum of the income received by the households, less tax on the income and wealth, social insurance contribution and current transfers.

structure:Code.common:Name: Household debt to gross domestic product (GDP) (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Household debt to gross domestic product. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Household debt to gross domestic product (GDP), Household debt
structure:Code.common:Description: Household debt to gross domestic product. The outstanding amount of current and non-contingent liabilities (such as loans, debt securities) that require payment of principal or interest in the future.

structure:Code.common:Name: Household debt to household disposal income (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Household debt to household disposal income. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Household debt to household disposal income, Gross disposable income
structure:Code.common:Description: Household debt to household disposal income. The remainder of the sum of the income received by the households, less tax on the income and wealth, social insurance contribution and current transfers.

structure:Code.common:Name: Household debt to household disposal income, Household debt
structure:Code.common:Description: Household debt to household disposal income. The outstanding amount of current and non-contingent liabilities (such as loans, debt securities) that require payment of principal or interest in the future.

structure:Code.common:Name: Interest margin to gross income (Core FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest margin to gross income. Core FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Interest margin to gross income, Gross income
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest margin to gross income. The sum of net income from insurance activity and other operating income.

structure:Code.common:Name: Interest margin to gross income, Interest margin
structure:Code.common:Description: Interest margin to gross income. The difference between interest income and interest expense.

structure:Code.common:Name: Large exposures to capital (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Large exposures to capital. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Large exposures to capital, Tier 1 capital
structure:Code.common:Description: Large exposures to capital. Comprises paid-up shares and common stock, and disclosed reserves that are available to meet claims against the deposit taker, with deductions such as goodwill. It is a supervisory concept defined by National regulation and based on Basel I, II, or III framework.

structure:Code.common:Name: Large exposures to capital, Value of large exposures
structure:Code.common:Description: Large exposures to capital. The sum of all exposure values of a deposit taker to a counterparty or to a group of connected counterparties, if it is equal to or above 10 percent of the deposit takers' eligible capital base define by the Regulatory framework.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liquid assets to estimated pension payments in the next year (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Liquid assets to estimated pension payments in the next year. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Liquid assets to estimated pension payments in the next year, Estimated pension payments in the next 12 months
structure:Code.common:Description: Liquid assets to estimated pension payments in the next year. The sum of the actuarially expected payments to beneficiaries by pension funds during the next year.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liquid assets to estimated pension payments in the next year, Liquid assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Liquid assets to estimated pension payments in the next year. Assets that are readily available to meet cash demands, including currency, deposits, and tradable securities that can be converted into cash with insignificant risk of change in value under normal business conditions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liquid assets to short term liabilities (Core FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Liquid assets to short term liabilities Core FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Liquid assets to short term liabilities, Liquid assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Liquid assets to short term liabilities Assets that are readily available to meet cash demands, including currency, deposits, and tradable securities that can be converted into cash with insignificant risk of change in value under normal business conditions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liquid assets to short term liabilities, Short term liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: Liquid assets to short term liabilities Liabilities that are due on demand or within three months or less.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liquid assets to total assets, Liquid assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Liquid assets to total assets. Assets that are readily available to meet cash demands, including currency, deposits, and tradable securities that can be converted into cash with insignificant risk of change in value under normal business conditions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liquid assets to total assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Liquid assets to total assets. Ratio of liquid assets to total assets, expressed as a percentage.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liquidity coverage ratio (Core FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Liquidity coverage ratio. Core FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Liquidity coverage ratio, High quality liquid assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Liquidity coverage ratio. Assets held by deposit takers to meet short-term liquidity needs during periods of financial stress. These assets are characterized by their low risk, high credit quality, and ability to be quickly converted into cash with minimal loss in value, and the scope of these assets is defined by the national regulatory framework based on Basel III framework.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liquidity coverage ratio, Total net cash outflows
structure:Code.common:Description: Liquidity coverage ratio. Supervisory concept defined in Basel III as the total expected cash outflows minus the total expected cash inflows in the specified stress scenario for the subsequent 30 calendar days.

structure:Code.common:Name: Loan concentration by economic activity
structure:Code.common:Description: Loan concentration by economic activity.

structure:Code.common:Name: Loan concentration by economic activity (Core FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Loan concentration by economic activity. Core FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Loan concentration by economic activity, Total gross loans to nonfinancial corporations
structure:Code.common:Description: Loan concentration by economic activity. Loans granted to non-financial corporations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Loans to Advanced Economies
structure:Code.common:Description: Loans to advanced economies. Loans extended to non-residents domiciled in Advanced Economies.

structure:Code.common:Name: Loans to Domestic Economy
structure:Code.common:Description: Loans to Domestic Economy. Loans to Domestic Economy

structure:Code.common:Name: Loans to Emerging and Developing Asia
structure:Code.common:Description: Loans to emerging and developing asia. Loans extended to non-residents domiciled in Emerging and Developing Asia.

structure:Code.common:Name: Loans to Emerging and Developing Europe
structure:Code.common:Description: Loans to emerging and developing europe. Loans extended to non-residents domiciled in Emerging and Developing Europe.

structure:Code.common:Name: Loans to Emerging Market and Developing Economies
structure:Code.common:Description: Loans to emerging market and developing economies. Loans extended to non-residents domiciled in Emerging Market and Developing Economies.

structure:Code.common:Name: Loans to Latin America and the Caribbean
structure:Code.common:Description: Loans to latin america and the caribbean. Loans extended to non-residents domiciled in Latin America and the Caribbean.

structure:Code.common:Name: Loans to Middle East and Central Asia
structure:Code.common:Description: Loans to middle east and central asia. Loans extended to non-residents domiciled in Middle East and Central Asia.

structure:Code.common:Name: Loans to Sub-Saharan Africa
structure:Code.common:Description: Loans to sub-saharan africa. Loans extended to non-residents domiciled in Sub-Saharan Africa.

structure:Code.common:Name: Maturity distribution of investments, Total investments
structure:Code.common:Description: Maturity distribution of investments The proportion of the Money market funds' investments held with Resident sectors.

structure:Code.common:Name: Maturity distribution of investments: >90 days (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Maturity distribution of investments: >90 days Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Maturity distribution of investments: 1-30 days (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Maturity distribution of investments: 1-30 days Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Maturity distribution of investments: 31-90 days (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Maturity distribution of investments: 31-90 days Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Net open position in foreign exchange to capital (Core FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Net open position in foreign exchange to capital Core FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Net open position in foreign exchange to capital, Net open position in foreign exchange
structure:Code.common:Description: Net open position in foreign exchange to capital The sum of the net position of on-balance sheet foreign currency debt instruments, net positions in financial derivatives, on-balance sheet holdings of foreign currency equity assets, and net position in foreign currency off-balance sheet items.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net open position in foreign exchange to capital, Total regulatory capital
structure:Code.common:Description: Net open position in foreign exchange to capital The sum of Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 (when applicable) capital, after accounting for regulatory adjustments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net stable funding ratio (Core FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Net stable funding ratio. Core FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Net stable funding ratio, Available amount of stable funding
structure:Code.common:Description: Net stable funding ratio. Supervisory concept defined by Basel III as the amount of capital and liability financing expected to be reliable sources of funds over a one-year time horizon under conditions of extended stress.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net stable funding ratio, Required amount of stable funding
structure:Code.common:Description: Net stable funding ratio. Supervisory concept defined by Basel III as the amount of stable funding needed to support deposit takers' assets and off-balance sheet activities over a one-year time horizon under conditions of extended stress.

structure:Code.common:Name: Noninterest expenses to gross income (Core FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Noninterest expenses to gross income. Core FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Noninterest expenses to gross income, Gross income
structure:Code.common:Description: Noninterest expenses to gross income. The sum of net income from insurance activity and other operating income.

structure:Code.common:Name: Noninterest expenses to gross income, Noninterest expenses
structure:Code.common:Description: Noninterest expenses to gross income. The operating expenses relating to the entity's ordinary business, such as personnel and other costs.

structure:Code.common:Name: Non-performing loans net of provisions to capital (Core FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Non-performing loans net of provisions to capital. Core FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Nonperforming loans net of provisions to capital, Nonperforming loans net of provisions
structure:Code.common:Description: Nonperforming loans net of provisions to capital. The amount of non-performing loans not covered by specific provisions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Nonperforming loans net of provisions to capital, Total regulatory capital
structure:Code.common:Description: Nonperforming loans net of provisions to capital. The sum of Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 (when applicable) capital, after accounting for regulatory adjustments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Nonperforming loans to total gross loans (Core FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Nonperforming loans to total gross loans. Core FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Nonperforming loans to total gross loans, Nonperforming loans
structure:Code.common:Description: Nonperforming loans to total gross loans. Loans for which (1) payments of interest or principal are past due by 90 days or more; or (2) interest payments equal to 90 days or more have been capitalized, refinanced, or rolled over; or (3) evidence exists to reclassify them as nonperforming even in the absence of a 90-day past due payment, such as when the debtor files for bankruptcy.

structure:Code.common:Name: Nonperforming loans to total gross loans, Total gross loans
structure:Code.common:Description: Nonperforming loans to total gross loans. Financial assets created from lending funds directly to debtors, and evidenced by documents that are not negotiable.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other financial corporations' (OFCs) assets to gross domestic product (GDP) (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Other financial corporations' (OFCs) assets to gross domestic product Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Other financial corporations' (OFCs) assets to gross domestic product (GDP), OFCs' assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Other financial corporations' (OFCs) assets to gross domestic product The sum of nonfinancial and financial assets of all financial corporation that are not classified as central bank or deposit takers.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other financial corporations' (OFCs) assets to total financial system assets (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Ratio of total assets to total financial system assets, expressed as a percentage. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Other financial corporations' (OFCs) assets to total financial system assets, Assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Ratio of total assets to total financial system assets, expressed as a percentage. Assets

structure:Code.common:Name: Personnel expenses to noninterest expenses (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Personnel expenses to noninterest expenses. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Personnel expenses to noninterest expenses, Noninterest expenses
structure:Code.common:Description: Personnel expenses to noninterest expenses. The operating expenses relating to the entity's ordinary business, such as personnel and other costs.

structure:Code.common:Name: Personnel expenses to noninterest expenses, Personnel costs
structure:Code.common:Description: Personnel expenses to noninterest expenses. Total remuneration, in cash or in kind, payable to employees for work done during the accounting period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Provisions to nonperforming loans (Core FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Provisions to nonperforming loans. Core FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Provisions to nonperforming loans, Nonperforming loans
structure:Code.common:Description: Provisions to nonperforming loans. Loans for which (1) payments of interest or principal are past due by 90 days or more; or (2) interest payments equal to 90 days or more have been capitalized, refinanced, or rolled over; or (3) evidence exists to reclassify them as nonperforming even in the absence of a 90-day past due payment, such as when the debtor files for bankruptcy.

structure:Code.common:Name: Provisions to nonperforming loans, Specific provisions
structure:Code.common:Description: Provisions to nonperforming loans. The outstanding amount of provisions made against the value of individual non-performing loans, collectively assessed groups of loans, and non-performing loans to other Deposit takers, in accordance with the national regulatory framework.

structure:Code.common:Name: Regulatory capital to risk-weighted assets (Core FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Regulatory capital to risk-weighted assets. Core FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Regulatory capital to risk-weighted assets, Risk-weighted assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Regulatory capital to risk-weighted assets. Total of all on- and off-balance-sheet exposures weighted according to their perceived risk (credit, market, operational).

structure:Code.common:Name: Regulatory capital to risk-weighted assets, Total regulatory capital
structure:Code.common:Description: Regulatory capital to risk-weighted assets. The sum of Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 (when applicable) capital, after accounting for regulatory adjustments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Residential real estate loans to total gross loans (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Residential real estate loans to total gross loans. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Residential real estate loans to total gross loans, Residential real estate loans
structure:Code.common:Description: Residential real estate loans to total gross loans. Loans collateralized by residential real estate (houses, apartments, other dwellings, and any associated land intended for occupancy by individual households).

structure:Code.common:Name: Residential real estate loans to total gross loans, Total gross loans
structure:Code.common:Description: Residential real estate loans to total gross loans. Financial assets created from lending funds directly to debtors, and evidenced by documents that are not negotiable.

structure:Code.common:Name: Residential real estate prices (percentage change/last 12 months) (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Residential real estate prices (percentage change/last 12 months). Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Return on assets (Life insurance only), Average total assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Return on assets (Life insurance only). The average value of total assets from the start of the calendar year to the end of the current reporting period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Return on assets (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: The quotient of net income before taxes and total (financial and nonfinancial) assets, expressed as a percentage. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Return on assets (Core FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: The quotient of net income before taxes and total (financial and nonfinancial) assets, expressed as a percentage. Core FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Return on assets, Annualized net income before taxes
structure:Code.common:Description: The quotient of net income before taxes and total (financial and nonfinancial) assets, expressed as a percentage. The estimated total net income before tax that the institutional unit would earn over a year, calculated based on the amount earned and accumulated from the start of the calendar year to the end of the current reporting period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Return on assets, Average total assets
structure:Code.common:Description: The quotient of net income before taxes and total (financial and nonfinancial) assets, expressed as a percentage. The average value of total assets from the start of the calendar year to the end of the current reporting period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Return on assets, Net income before taxes
structure:Code.common:Description: The quotient of net income before taxes and total (financial and nonfinancial) assets, expressed as a percentage. The estimated total net income before tax that the institutional unit would earn over a year, calculated based on the amount earned and accumulated from the start of the calendar year to the end of the current reporting period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Return on equity (Life insurance and nonlife insurance), Annualized net income after taxes
structure:Code.common:Description: Return on equity (Life insurance and nonlife insurance). The estimated total net income after taxes that the institutional unit would earn over a year, calculated based on the amount earned and accumulated from the start of the calendar year to the end of the current reporting period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Return on equity (Life insurance and nonlife insurance), Average capital and reserves
structure:Code.common:Description: Return on equity (Life insurance and nonlife insurance). The average value of capital and reserves from the start of the calendar year to the end of the current reporting period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Return on equity (Life insurance only), Annualized net income after taxes
structure:Code.common:Description: Return on equity (Life insurance only). The estimated total net income after taxes that the institutional unit would earn over a year, calculated based on the amount earned and accumulated from the start of the calendar year to the end of the current reporting period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Return on equity (Life insurance only), Average capital and reserves
structure:Code.common:Description: Return on equity (Life insurance only). The average value of capital and reserves from the start of the calendar year to the end of the current reporting period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Return on equity (Nonlife insurance only), Annualized net income after taxes
structure:Code.common:Description: Return on equity (Nonlife insurance only). The estimated total net income after taxes that the institutional unit would earn over a year, calculated based on the amount earned and accumulated from the start of the calendar year to the end of the current reporting period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Return on equity (Nonlife insurance only), Average capital and reserves
structure:Code.common:Description: Return on equity (Nonlife insurance only). The average value of capital and reserves from the start of the calendar year to the end of the current reporting period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Return on equity (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: The quotient of net income after taxes and total capital and reserves, expressed as a percentage. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Return on equity (Core FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: The quotient of net income after taxes and total capital and reserves, expressed as a percentage. Core FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Return on equity, Annualized net income after taxes
structure:Code.common:Description: The quotient of net income after taxes and total capital and reserves, expressed as a percentage. The estimated total net income after taxes that the institutional unit would earn over a year, calculated based on the amount earned and accumulated from the start of the calendar year to the end of the current reporting period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Return on equity, Capital
structure:Code.common:Description: The quotient of net income after taxes and total capital and reserves, expressed as a percentage. The average value of capital and reserves from the start of the calendar year to the end of the current reporting period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Return on equity, Equity
structure:Code.common:Description: The quotient of net income after taxes and total capital and reserves, expressed as a percentage. The difference between total assets and total liabilities in the balance sheet, and it represents the equity interest of the owners in an entity and is the amount available to absorb unidentified losses.

structure:Code.common:Name: Return on equity, Net income after taxes
structure:Code.common:Description: The quotient of net income after taxes and total capital and reserves, expressed as a percentage. The remainder of net income after deducting income tax.

structure:Code.common:Name: Sectoral distribution of investments: Non-financial corporations

structure:Code.common:Name: Shareholder equity to total invested assets (life insurance and nonlife insurance), Capital and reserves
structure:Code.common:Description: Shareholder equity to total invested assets (life insurance and nonlife insurance). The difference between total assets and total liabilities in the balance sheet, and it represents the equity interest of the owners in an entity and is the amount available to absorb unidentified losses.

structure:Code.common:Name: Shareholder equity to total invested assets (Life insurance only), Capital and reserves
structure:Code.common:Description: Shareholder equity to total invested assets (Life insurance only). The difference between total assets and total liabilities in the balance sheet, and it represents the equity interest of the owners in an entity and is the amount available to absorb unidentified losses.

structure:Code.common:Name: Shareholder equity to total invested assets (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Shareholder equity to total invested assets Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Shareholder equity to total invested assets, Capital and reserves
structure:Code.common:Description: Shareholder equity to total invested assets The difference between total assets and total liabilities in the balance sheet, and it represents the equity interest of the owners in an entity and is the amount available to absorb unidentified losses.

structure:Code.common:Name: Shareholder equity to total invested assets, Total invested assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Shareholder equity to total invested assets Total value of financial assets and property for investment.

structure:Code.common:Name: Spread between highest and lowest interbank rates (basis points) (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Spread between highest and lowest interbank rates (basis points). Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Spread between highest and lowest interbank rates (basis points), Highest interbank rate
structure:Code.common:Description: Spread between highest and lowest interbank rates (basis points). The highest interest rate charged on interbank loans. It is computed as the average of highest interbank rates on same maturity loans (daily or weekly) during the reporting period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Spread between highest and lowest interbank rates (basis points), Lowest interbank rate
structure:Code.common:Description: Spread between highest and lowest interbank rates (basis points). The lowest interest rate charged on interbank loans. It is computed as the average of lowest interbank rates on same maturity loans (daily or weekly) during the reporting period.

structure:Code.common:Name: Spread between reference lending and deposit rates (basis points) (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Spread between reference lending and deposit rates (base points). Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Spread between reference lending and deposit rates (basis points), Reference deposit rate
structure:Code.common:Description: Spread between reference lending and deposit rates (base points). The weighted average interest rate on loans / deposits during the period, excluding interest charged on loans / deposits between deposit takers.

structure:Code.common:Name: Spread between reference lending and deposit rates (basis points), Reference lending rate
structure:Code.common:Description: Spread between reference lending and deposit rates (base points). Series for further analysis of the balance sheet, Reference lending rates.

structure:Code.common:Name: Tier 1 capital to assets (Core FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: The ratio of Tier 1 capital to total balance sheet assets or the Basel III exposure measure, expressed as a percentage. Core FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Tier 1 capital to assets, Tier 1 capital
structure:Code.common:Description: The ratio of Tier 1 capital to total balance sheet assets or the Basel III exposure measure, expressed as a percentage. Comprises paid-up shares and common stock, and disclosed reserves that are available to meet claims against the deposit taker, with deductions such as goodwill. It is a supervisory concept defined by National regulation and based on Basel I, II, or III framework.

structure:Code.common:Name: Tier 1 capital to assets, Total assets
structure:Code.common:Description: The ratio of Tier 1 capital to total balance sheet assets or the Basel III exposure measure, expressed as a percentage. The sum of nonfinancial and financial assets, representing the total resources owned by the institutional unit.

structure:Code.common:Name: Tier 1 capital to risk-weighted assets (Core FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Tier 1 capital to risk-weighted assets. Core FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Tier 1 capital to risk-weighted assets, Risk-weighted assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Tier 1 capital to risk-weighted assets. Total of all on- and off-balance-sheet exposures weighted according to their perceived risk (credit, market, operational).

structure:Code.common:Name: Tier 1 capital to risk-weighted assets, Tier 1 capital
structure:Code.common:Description: Tier 1 capital to risk-weighted assets. Comprises paid-up shares and common stock, and disclosed reserves that are available to meet claims against the deposit taker, with deductions such as goodwill. It is a supervisory concept defined by National regulation and based on Basel I, II, or III framework.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total debt to equity (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Total debt to equity. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Total debt to equity, Equity
structure:Code.common:Description: Total debt to equity. The difference between total assets and total liabilities in the balance sheet, and it represents the equity interest of the owners in an entity and is the amount available to absorb unidentified losses.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total debt to equity, Total debt
structure:Code.common:Description: Total debt to equity. Financial instruments that are linked to another specific financial instrument, indicator, index, price, interest rate, or commodity, and through which specific financial risks can be traded in their own right in financial markets. Employee stock options are contracts that give employees the right to purchase shares of their employer's stock at a predetermined price, usually as part of their compensation package.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total debt to gross domestic product (GDP) (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Total debt to gross domestic product (GDP). Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Total debt to gross domestic product (GDP), Total debt
structure:Code.common:Description: Total debt to gross domestic product (GDP). Financial instruments that are linked to another specific financial instrument, indicator, index, price, interest rate, or commodity, and through which specific financial risks can be traded in their own right in financial markets. Employee stock options are contracts that give employees the right to purchase shares of their employer's stock at a predetermined price, usually as part of their compensation package.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total gross loans
structure:Code.common:Description: Total gross loans. Financial assets created from lending funds directly to debtors, and evidenced by documents that are not negotiable.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total invested assets (Core FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Total value of financial assets and property for investment. Core FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Trading income to total income (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Trading income to total income. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Trading income to total income, Gross income
structure:Code.common:Description: Trading income to total income. The sum of net income from insurance activity and other operating income.

structure:Code.common:Name: Trading income to total income, Trading income
structure:Code.common:Description: Trading income to total income. Realized and unrealized gains and losses during the period on all financial instruments (assets and liabilities) that are held at Fair value through profit and loss on the balance sheet.

structure:Code.common:Name: Insurance corporations' assets to total financial system assets, Insurance corporations' assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Ratio of total assets to total financial system assets, expressed as a percentage. The sum of nonfinancial and financial assets of insurance corporations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Money market funds' assets to total financial system assets, Money Market Funds' assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Ratio of total assets to total financial system assets, expressed as a percentage. The sum of nonfinancial and financial assets of money market funds.

structure:Code.common:Name: Insurance corporations' assets to gross domestic product (GDP), Insurance corporations' assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Insurance corporations' assets to gross domestic product The sum of nonfinancial and financial assets of insurance corporations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Pension funds' assets to total financial system assets, Pension funds' assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Ratio of total assets to total financial system assets, expressed as a percentage. The sum of nonfinancial and financial assets of pension funds.

structure:Code.common:Name: Money market funds' assets to gross domestic product (GDP), Money Market Funds' assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Money market funds' assets to gross domestic product The sum of nonfinancial and financial assets of money market funds.

structure:Code.common:Name: Insurance corporations' assets to total financial system assets (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Ratio of total assets to total financial system assets, expressed as a percentage. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Money market funds' assets to total financial system assets (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Ratio of total assets to total financial system assets, expressed as a percentage. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Pension funds' assets to gross domestic product (GDP), Pension funds' assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Pension funds' assets to gross domestic product The sum of nonfinancial and financial assets of pension funds.

structure:Code.common:Name: Pension funds' assets to total financial system assets (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Ratio of total assets to total financial system assets, expressed as a percentage. Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Insurance corporations' assets to gross domestic product (GDP) (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Insurance corporations' assets to gross domestic product Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Money market funds' assets to gross domestic product (GDP) (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Money market funds' assets to gross domestic product Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign currency denominated loans to total loans, Total gross loans
structure:Code.common:Description: Foreign currency denominated loans to total loans Financial assets created from lending funds directly to debtors, and evidenced by documents that are not negotiable.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liquid assets to total assets, Total assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Liquid assets to total assets. The sum of nonfinancial and financial assets, representing the total resources owned by the institutional unit.

structure:Code.common:Name: Pension funds' assets to gross domestic product (GDP) (Additional FSI)
structure:Code.common:Description: Pension funds' assets to gross domestic product Additional FSIs

structure:Code.common:Name: Return on assets (Life insurance only), Net income before taxes
structure:Code.common:Description: Return on assets (Life insurance only). The estimated total net income before tax that the institutional unit would earn over a year, calculated based on the amount earned and accumulated from the start of the calendar year to the end of the current reporting period.

structure:Codelist.common:Name: Accounting Entry
structure:Codelist.common:Description: This codelist identifies whether a transaction represents a use of resources, a source of funds, an asset, a liability, or a change in equity.

structure:Code.common:Name: Total
structure:Code.common:Description: The sum of all relevant components or categories.

structure:Code.common:Name: Not allocated/unspecified
structure:Code.common:Description: Not specified or detailed.

structure:Code.common:Name: Not applicable
structure:Code.common:Description: Not applicable or relevant in the given context.

structure:Code.common:Name: Assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Assets is store of value, over which ownership rights are enforced and from which their owners may derive economic benefits by holding them over a period of time (2016 MFSMCG glossary).

structure:Code.common:Name: Assets, Claims on
structure:Code.common:Description: Assets, Claims on

structure:Code.common:Name: Assets, Claims on, Credit to
structure:Code.common:Description: Assets, Claims on, Credit to

structure:Code.common:Name: Assets, Claims on, Other claims on
structure:Code.common:Description: Assets, Claims on, Other claims on

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross sales of assets (decrease)
structure:Code.common:Description: The total value of asset sales, representing a decrease in asset holdings.

structure:Code.common:Name: Assets (gross)
structure:Code.common:Description: Gross assets refer to the total value of all assets owned or held by an individual, organization, or entity before accounting for any deductions, such as depreciation or liabilities

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross acquisition of assets (increase)
structure:Code.common:Description: The total value of assets acquired, representing an increase in asset holdings.

structure:Code.common:Name: Assets (net)
structure:Code.common:Description: Assets is store of value, over which ownership rights are enforced and from which their owners may derive economic benefits by holding them over a period of time (2016 MFSMCG glossary).

structure:Code.common:Name: Assets - short position
structure:Code.common:Description: Store of value representing a benefit or series of benefits accruing to the economic owner by holding or using the entity over a period of time. It is a means of carrying forward value from one accounting period to another.

structure:Code.common:Name: Assets (short or negative positions)
structure:Code.common:Description: Assets that are either shorted or have negative positions due to borrowing or other financial obligations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Balance (credits minus debits)
structure:Code.common:Description: The difference between the total credits and debits in an account, representing net credit position.

structure:Code.common:Name: Credit (Resources)
structure:Code.common:Description: Credits related to resource inflows, including financial and non-financial resources.

structure:Code.common:Name: Credit (Environment + Economy)
structure:Code.common:Description: Credits accounted for within the context of both environmental and economic transactions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Credit/Revenue
structure:Code.common:Description: Credit entries relate to exports of goods and services, earned income receivable, transfer income receivable and disposals of non-produced non-financial assets (the financial account in the external accounts uses the terms net acquisition of financial assets and net incurrence of liabilities rather than credit and debit).

structure:Code.common:Name: Contingent liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: Liabilities that may occur depending on the outcome of a future event, as defined in the European System of Accounts (ESA) and Government Finance Statistics (GFS).

structure:Code.common:Name: Claims
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial claims on other entities

structure:Code.common:Name: Credit to
structure:Code.common:Description: Credit to

structure:Code.common:Name: Credit (excluding exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: Credits that exclude any exceptional financing measures such as bailouts or special financial assistance.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debit (Uses)
structure:Code.common:Description: Debit entries relate to imports of goods and services, earned income payable, transfer income payable and acquisitions of non-produced non-financial assets (the financial account in the external accounts uses the terms net acquisition of financial assets and net incurrence of liabilities rather than credit and debit).

structure:Code.common:Name: Debit (Environment + Economy)
structure:Code.common:Description: Debits accounted for within the context of both environmental and economic transactions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Domestic (adjustment)
structure:Code.common:Description: Adjustments made to domestic accounts to reflect accurate financial positions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Debit/Expenditure
structure:Code.common:Description: Outflows or payments made, representing expenditures.

structure:Code.common:Name: End use
structure:Code.common:Description: The final consumption or utilization of goods and services.

structure:Code.common:Name: End use (Environment + Economy)
structure:Code.common:Description: The final consumption or utilization of goods and services within the context of both environmental and economic considerations.

structure:Code.common:Name: End use, of which emissions relevant
structure:Code.common:Description: End use of goods and services where emissions are a significant factor.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liabilities (domestic)
structure:Code.common:Description: Obligations where one unit (the debtor) is obliged, under specific circumstances, to provide funds or other resources to another unit (the creditor). These include shares and other equity in corporations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Transformation use
structure:Code.common:Description: Use of resources or funds for transformation activities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Transformation use (Environment + Economy)
structure:Code.common:Description: Use of resources or funds for transformation activities within the context of environmental and economic considerations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Economy to environment
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial flows or impacts from economic activities to environmental resources or impacts.

structure:Code.common:Name: Environment to economy
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial flows or impacts from environmental resources or activities to the economy.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Assets that are in the form of cash, stocks, bonds, or other financial instruments.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial assets (adjustment)
structure:Code.common:Description: Adjustments made to the value or reporting of financial assets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial assets (domestic)
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial assets held within the domestic economy.

structure:Code.common:Name: Foreign (adjustment)
structure:Code.common:Description: Adjustments made to foreign accounts to reflect accurate financial positions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Financial assets (foreign)
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial assets held in foreign entities or markets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Inflows (reserves template)
structure:Code.common:Description: Incoming funds or resources within the context of a reserves template.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net flows (reserves template)
structure:Code.common:Description: Net inflows or outflows within the context of a reserves template.

structure:Code.common:Name: Outflows (reserves template)
structure:Code.common:Description: Outgoing funds or resources within the context of a reserves template.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross
structure:Code.common:Description: The total value before any deductions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net income on inward FDI
structure:Code.common:Description: The net income generated from inward foreign direct investment.

structure:Code.common:Name: Inflows
structure:Code.common:Description: The incoming funds or resources.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net income on outward FDI
structure:Code.common:Description: The net income generated from outward foreign direct investment.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: Obligations where one unit (the debtor) is obliged, under specific circumstances, to provide funds or other resources to another unit (the creditor). These include shares and other equity in corporations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liabilities (adjustment)
structure:Code.common:Description: Obligations where one unit (the debtor) is obliged, under specific circumstances, to provide funds or other resources to another unit (the creditor). These include shares and other equity in corporations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross decrease in liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: The total reduction in liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liabilities (foreign)
structure:Code.common:Description: Obligations where one unit (the debtor) is obliged, under specific circumstances, to provide funds or other resources to another unit (the creditor). These include shares and other equity in corporations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liabilities (gross)
structure:Code.common:Description: Gross liabilities refer to the total value of all obligations or debts owed by an individual, organization, or entity before accounting for any adjustments or offsets

structure:Code.common:Name: Gross incurrence of liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: The total value of liabilities incurred before any deductions.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liabilities to
structure:Code.common:Description: Obligations where one unit (the debtor) is obliged, under specific circumstances, to provide funds or other resources to another unit (the creditor). These include shares and other equity in corporations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liabilities to, Claims on
structure:Code.common:Description: Liabilities to, Claims on

structure:Code.common:Name: Liabilities: Unofficial
structure:Code.common:Description: Obligations where one unit (the debtor) is obliged, under specific circumstances, to provide funds or other resources to another unit (the creditor). These include shares and other equity in corporations.. Liabilities that are not necessarily recognized by official records or entities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liabilities (excluding exceptional financing)
structure:Code.common:Description: Obligations where one unit (the debtor) is obliged, under specific circumstances, to provide funds or other resources to another unit (the creditor). These include shares and other equity in corporations.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net (assets minus liabilities)
structure:Code.common:Description: The net value obtained by subtracting total liabilities from total assets.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net acquisition of financial assets other than cash
structure:Code.common:Description: The net result of acquiring financial assets excluding cash.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net Claims on
structure:Code.common:Description: Financial claims on other entities less liabilities to the same entity

structure:Code.common:Name: Net Claims on, Claims on
structure:Code.common:Description: Net Claims on, Claims on

structure:Code.common:Name: Net Claims on, Liabilities to
structure:Code.common:Description: Net Claims on, Liabilities to

structure:Code.common:Name: Net Credit to
structure:Code.common:Description: Net Credit to

structure:Code.common:Name: Net Credit to, Claims on
structure:Code.common:Description: Net Credit to, Claims on

structure:Code.common:Name: Net Credit, Liabilities to
structure:Code.common:Description: Net Credit, Liabilities to

structure:Code.common:Name: Net Liabilities (liabilities minus assets)
structure:Code.common:Description: The net value obtained by subtracting total assets from total liabilities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Negative Credit/Revenue
structure:Code.common:Description: A situation where credits or revenues are negative, indicating a deficit or loss.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net (acquisitions less disposals)
structure:Code.common:Description: The net result of total acquisitions minus total disposals.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net (assets less liabilities)
structure:Code.common:Description: Net refers to the value of assets less the value of liabilities

structure:Code.common:Name: Net (credits less debits)
structure:Code.common:Description: The net result of total credits minus total debits.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net (liabilities less assets)
structure:Code.common:Description: Net refers to the value of liabilities less the value of assets

structure:Code.common:Name: Net (receivables less payables)
structure:Code.common:Description: The net result of total receivables minus total payables.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net foreign assets
structure:Code.common:Description: Net foreign assets

structure:Code.common:Name: Net Foreign Assets, Claims on
structure:Code.common:Description: Net Foreign Assets, Claims on

structure:Code.common:Name: Net Foreign Assets, Liabilities to
structure:Code.common:Description: Net Foreign Assets, Liabilities to

structure:Code.common:Name: Balance on goods, services, and income
structure:Code.common:Description: The net balance of trade in goods, services, and income flows between countries.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net FDI inward
structure:Code.common:Description: The net result of foreign direct investment inflows.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net FDI outward
structure:Code.common:Description: The net result of foreign direct investment outflows.

structure:Code.common:Name: Other Liabilities to
structure:Code.common:Description: Other Liabilities to

structure:Code.common:Name: Provided by
structure:Code.common:Description: Resources or funds provided by an entity.

structure:Code.common:Name: Private liabilities
structure:Code.common:Description: Obligations where one unit (the debtor) is obliged, under specific circumstances, to provide funds or other resources to another unit (the creditor). These include shares and other equity in corporations.. Liabilities with private entities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Provided to
structure:Code.common:Description: Resources or funds provided to an entity.

structure:Code.common:Name: Liabilities: Official
structure:Code.common:Description: Obligations where one unit (the debtor) is obliged, under specific circumstances, to provide funds or other resources to another unit (the creditor). These include shares and other equity in corporations. Liabilities that are not necessarily recognized by official records or entities.

structure:Code.common:Name: Net (net acquisition of financial assets less net incurrence of liabilities)
structure:Code.common:Description: The difference between net acquisition of financial assets and the net incurrence of liabilities in an accounting period.
